tagline: The memory of your tasks, organised
demo_banner: Demo mode: fictional sessions, nothing of yours is shown
local_banner: Local only: your sessions never leave this machine
home_title: Which task do you want to get back to?
home_lead: Each task gathers what was done, what was decided and why, and what is still pending, without rereading long conversations.
search_placeholder: Search tasks, e.g. ABC-123, a branch name, or a word from a saved capsule
no_sessions: No Claude Code sessions found. Run Claude Code in a project first, or try --demo.
unassigned_hint: These sessions have no task key and no feature branch. Name your branches after the task, or mention a task key in your prompts, and they will be grouped.
copied: Copied! Paste it into a new Claude session
copy_failed: Could not copy, select the text below
no_capsule_text: ✨ Generating it asks Claude to read the relevant parts of your sessions and write the record. You see the estimated cost first and confirm before anything is spent.
regenerate_hint: Shows an estimate and asks you first; nothing is spent until you confirm.
estimate_text: Estimated: about {tokens} tokens, {usd} and {seconds}s, {calls} Claude calls over {sessions} session(s). This is a rough estimate; the real usage is shown afterwards.
no_reason: no reason found in the evidence
commits_possible: Same time window, no task key (may belong to another task)
undone: possibly undone by a later reset?
timeline_time_hint: Local time of the first message this row cites
search_note: Free search matches the exact words you type. ✨ AI search understands meaning (it shows an estimate first and uses tokens).
ai_search: ✨ Improve with AI: search by meaning
ai_search_empty: Type what you are looking for first.
ai_estimate_text: Estimated: about {tokens} tokens, {usd}, over {tasks} tasks. This is a rough estimate; the real usage is shown afterwards.
ai_no_matches: The AI found no task that matches. Try other words.
progress_writing: Claude is writing… about {tokens} tokens so far
progress_cancelled: Cancelled. Nothing was saved. Calls that had already finished still count in the usage counter.
stage_scan: Scanning your sessions for this task
stage_redact: Masking secrets before anything is sent
stage_votes: Asking Claude which turns belong to the task
ev_redact_done: Masked {masked} secret-like string(s) in the text that can be sent ({turns} prompts checked)
ev_redact_none: Checked {turns} prompts: no secret-like strings found
ev_votes_start: Session {session}: asking Claude {votes} time(s) over {turns} prompts
ev_vote_failed: Vote {n}/{of} gave no usable answer (session {session}).{reason} The other votes still count.
ev_votes_fallback: No usable vote for session {session}: using the built-in heuristic instead
ev_votes_skipped: No AI selection needed: the whole of {sessions} session(s) belongs to the task
ev_merge_done: Merged: {turns} turns across {sessions} session(s) in {ranges} range(s)
ev_evidence_done: Found {files} file(s) and {commits} commit(s); the evidence is {chars} characters
ev_write_start: Claude is reading the evidence and writing the record
ev_validate_done: Kept {kept} of {total} decisions and findings; dropped {dropped} without evidence
ev_validate_dropped: Dropped {dropped} item(s) that had no valid citation
ev_ask_start: Asking Claude which of {tasks} tasks match “{query}”
ev_rank_done: Kept {matches} matching task(s); dropped {dropped} that were not real
search_hit_task: Matched the task name, repos or first prompt
search_scope: Free search looked inside {capsules} saved capsule(s). The other {others} task(s) can only be found by their name, repos and first prompt, until you generate their capsule.
search_scope_all: Free search looked inside all {capsules} saved capsule(s).
search_scope_none: No capsules are saved yet, so free search only sees task names, repos and first prompts. Generating a capsule makes its text searchable.
search_none_hint: Free search is literal: it needs those exact words (any case or accent). If you remember the idea but not the words, ✨ search by meaning can help. It uses tokens, so you see an estimate and confirm first.
files_hint: Click a file to see which other tasks touched it.
files_none_other: No other task touched this file, as far as Claude sessions show.
files_basis_capsule: Read from the saved capsule of this task.
files_basis_session: Approximate: every file Claude edited in this task's sessions. A session can cover several tasks.
files_basis_mention: Approximate: files Claude edited from the first prompt that mentions this task onwards.
files_incomplete_note: This list may be incomplete. It only knows what Claude changed in the sessions it can read: changes you made by hand or in other tools are missing, and so are edits made by subagents in tasks that have no capsule yet.
files_find_placeholder: Part of a file path, e.g. cart/total
files_find_top: Files touched by the most tasks
files_find_none: No file matches. Only files edited in Claude sessions are known.
evidence_open_hint: Show the original message behind this citation
evidence_open_label: Show the original message: session {session}, message {turn}
evidence_resume_hint: Paste it in a terminal to reopen that exact conversation in Claude Code.
evidence_context: The cited message (highlighted) with the messages around it. Secrets are hidden.
evidence_unverified: This citation points outside the messages the capsule was written from, so it may not be the right one. Check it before trusting it.
evidence_error_hint: The capsule is still valid; only this evidence could not be shown.
tl_hint: One row per task, one dot per day with prompts in its sessions: a bigger dot means more prompts. The thin line only joins the first and last day, it is not time worked.
tl_note: Dates are approximate: a session that mixes several tasks counts for every task its prompts cite.
tl_empty: No dated activity matches these filters.
tl_table_caption: Task activity, one row per task
coverage_title: Show only the tasks without a capsule
coverage_filter_on: Showing only tasks without a capsule
tl_showing_unassigned: Showing {shown} of {total} tasks, plus sessions without a task key
tl_undated: {n} without dated activity are not on the timeline
tl_range_swapped: From was after To, so the two dates were swapped.
sessions_note: Your own messages in the sessions of this task, read from your computer. Free: no AI and no tokens. Open a session and click a message to read the original conversation around it.
sessions_mixed_note: Some sessions also hold other tasks: messages that mention {key} are highlighted, the others are dimmer but may still belong to this task.
sessions_empty_mine: No message of this session cites {key}.
sessions_empty_new: No new messages in this session.
sessions_noise: {n} automatic messages (such as interrupted requests) are not listed.
sessions_marking: Highlighted: messages that mention {key}. The others may still belong to this task.
sessions_no_capsule_hint: Not sure yet? You can read what was said in this task for free first.
stale_update_hint: Updating regenerates the whole capsule with AI and uses tokens. You see the estimate first and nothing is spent until you confirm.
